visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two pale-skinned hands, one wearing a silver wedding band and the other a black beaded bracelet, are placed flat over a young child's face, completely obscuring their features. The child is wearing a navy blue Keith Haring brand t-shirt featuring a stylized skater graphic. (2) The hands move apart in a deliberate motion to reveal the child's face, forming a frame with the palms and fingers. The child has short black hair and a neutral, calm expression as they look directly at the camera. (3) The adult hands press into the child's cheeks from both sides, pushing the facial tissue upward and inward. This causes the child's mouth to pucker and their eyes to squint slightly, while the child remains still. (4) The hands quickly snap back to the center, covering the child's face again in a repetitive cycle. The lighting is soft and consistent, highlighting the texture of the beige sofa in the background. (5) The hands pull away again to frame the face, and the child's expression shifts from neutral to a slight smile. The camera remains static and at eye-level throughout this indoor interaction. (6) In a rapid final sequence, the hands squish the child's face multiple times in quick succession. The child responds with a joyful, toothy laugh, eyes closed tight and tongue sticking out playfully.
